product_overview: SAD Carcinicultura is a web-based decision support system for shrimp farming operations. It centralizes production, biological, environmental, and financial data to help users monitor cycles, register field activities, analyze indicators, and support management decisions.
core_goals: Centralize operational, biological, environmental, and financial data for shrimp farming activities
Track pond and cycle lifecycle from stocking through monitoring and closure
Record biometrics, environmental readings, and feeding activities from the field
Calculate biological and financial indicators such as density, biomass, FCA, revenue, costs, profit, margin, ROA, and ROE
Provide integrated dashboards, alerts, and explainable recommendations for management decisions
Support scenario simulation for harvest and commercial planning
Maintain auditability, permissions, and traceability across user actions and data changes

features.name: Authentication and Access Control
features.description: Users sign in to access protected farming data and are authorized according to their role and organizational scope.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill in email -> Fill in password -> Submit login form -> See the authorized landing area
Navigate to /login -> Fill in invalid credentials -> Submit login form -> See an invalid credentials message

features.name: Manager Dashboard
features.description: Managers view a consolidated overview of shrimp farming performance, active cycles, and trends.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> View KPI summary cards -> Inspect active cycles and ponds list -> Review current farming status
Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> Apply organization and cycle filters -> View updated indicators and trends -> Review available submodule navigation

features.name: Pond and Cycle Management
features.description: Users configure organizations, properties, ponds, and cultivation cycles so operations can be tracked correctly.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/viveiros -> Create a pond record -> Enter pond identification and usable area -> Save the pond -> See the pond available for cycles
Navigate to /gestor/viveiros -> Edit an existing pond -> Update pond details -> Save changes -> See the updated record preserved in history
Navigate to /gestor/viveiros -> Inactivate a pond -> Confirm the action -> See the pond removed from active use while history remains available

features.name: Stocking Registration
features.description: Users start a cultivation cycle and register the initial stocking information for the pond.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/viveiros -> Start a new cycle -> Enter start date, species or lineage, post-larvae quantity, and origin -> Save the stocking record -> See the cycle open with initial population and density
Navigate to /gestor/viveiros -> Start a cycle with invalid quantity -> Submit the form -> See validation feedback for the invalid stocking data

features.name: Biometry Registration
features.description: Field users record sample measurements so the system can calculate average shrimp weight and support growth tracking.
user_flows: Navigate to /campo/biometria -> Select an active cycle -> Enter sample size and sample weights -> Fill in uniformity percentage -> Submit the biometric measurement -> See the calculated average weight
Navigate to /campo/biometria -> Select an active cycle -> Enter an invalid sample or inconsistent values -> Submit the measurement -> See validation feedback for the biometric entry

features.name: Environmental Condition Registration
features.description: Users register manual or integrated environmental measurements for the selected cycle or pond.
user_flows: Navigate to /campo/manejo -> Record an environmental reading -> Select the parameter and enter value, unit, timestamp, and origin -> Save the measurement -> See the reading stored with its source and quality context
Navigate to /campo/manejo -> Record a measurement with an invalid unit or value -> Submit the entry -> See validation feedback for the environmental reading

features.name: Biological Indicator Calculation
features.description: Users calculate and review biological indicators such as density, estimated population, biomass, and FCA based on recorded data.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> Select a cycle and period -> Request indicator calculation -> Review density, biomass, population estimate, and FCA results
Navigate to /gestor/simulacao -> Select a cycle -> Review the available biological inputs -> Compare indicator results across scenarios or ponds
Navigate to /campo/biometria -> Enter data with missing required inputs -> Submit the calculation request -> See a message that the indicator is unavailable because inputs are incomplete

features.name: Feeding Plan and Feeding Log
features.description: Users review feeding recommendations, record planned and delivered feed, and log leftover feed after feeding.
user_flows: Navigate to /campo/manejo -> Review the feeding recommendation -> Confirm the amount to provide -> Record the delivered feed -> Log the leftover feed afterward -> See the plan and execution linked in history

Navigate to /gestor/tabelas-alimentares -> Review the active feeding table -> Select the table version applicable to the cycle -> Return to feeding planning -> Use the selected reference in the recommendation
Navigate to /campo/manejo -> Enter feed data that is incompatible with the active cycle or missing context -> Submit the record -> See validation feedback for the feeding entry

features.name: Financial Records and Indicators
features.description: Users record operational costs and commercialization data and review financial indicators derived from those records.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/financeiro -> Register a cost entry -> Enter category, value, date, and period -> Save the cost -> See the operational cost reflected in the totals
Navigate to /gestor/financeiro -> Register a sale entry -> Enter biomass or quantity, price, gram weight range, and sale date -> Save the sale -> See revenue and profit indicators update
Navigate to /gestor/financeiro -> Review financial indicators -> Inspect revenue, operational cost, profit, margin, ROA, and ROE -> See unavailable indicators clearly marked when inputs are missing

features.name: Harvest Decision Simulation
features.description: Users simulate harvest timing and commercial scenarios without changing the actual recorded data.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/simulacao -> Select an active cycle -> Set the projection horizon -> Enter daily gain and market price -> Run the simulation -> Review the Delta V recommendation
Navigate to /gestor/simulacao -> Copy the realized scenario -> Change price or cost assumptions -> Run the simulation again -> Compare the simulated and realized results
Navigate to /gestor/simulacao -> Submit a simulation with incomplete required inputs -> See validation feedback or an unavailable result message

features.name: Integrated Dashboard Monitoring
features.description: Users review a unified dashboard with biological, environmental, operational, and financial information filtered by their authorized scope.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> Select organization, property, pond, cycle, and period -> View dashboards and trend charts -> Inspect alerts and recommendations
Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> Change filters to compare two cycles -> Review the updated visuals and indicators -> See the comparison within the authorized scope
Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> Choose a filter outside the authorized scope -> See access denied behavior and no protected data exposed

features.name: Alerts and Explainable Recommendations
features.description: The system generates alerts and recommendations that explain the inputs, limits, and context behind the result.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> Review an alert or recommendation -> Inspect the rule, severity, inputs, and limitations -> Acknowledge the item without removing history
Navigate to /gestor/simulacao -> Trigger a new calculation with context data -> Review the generated recommendation -> See the justification and versioned inputs
Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> Open an incomplete or uncalculable alert context -> See that the item is marked unavailable or incomplete rather than treated as a final diagnosis

features.name: Report and Data Export
features.description: Authorized users export reports or datasets for external analysis while preserving scope, filters, and metadata.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/dashboard -> Choose a report scope and period -> Export the report -> See the generated file with metadata and authorized filters
Navigate to /gestor/financeiro -> Select financial data for export -> Generate the file -> Download the report for external use
Navigate to /gestor/auditoria -> Export an audit view that is within permissions -> Receive the exported file with the selected traceability data

features.name: User, Role, and Parameter Administration
features.description: Administrators manage users, permissions, and versioned calculation parameters.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/usuarios -> Select a user -> Assign or remove a role -> Save the change -> See the updated permissions with history preserved
Navigate to /gestor/tabelas-alimentares -> Review parameter or table versions -> Update the active reference with a new version -> Save the change -> See the prior version preserved
Navigate to /gestor/usuarios -> Attempt to remove the last administrator from the organization -> See validation feedback that blocks the change

features.name: Audit and Traceability
features.description: Authorized users inspect historical actions, changes, and versioned calculation details for records and indicators.
user_flows: Navigate to /gestor/auditoria -> Apply filters for a record or event -> Review the audit timeline -> Open before and after details for a selected change
Navigate to /gestor/auditoria -> Select an indicator -> Trace it back to its inputs, formula version, and parameter versions -> Review the originating data and calculation history
Navigate to /gestor/auditoria -> Try to access an event outside the permitted scope -> See that protected audit data is not exposed
